description_en: You can invoke LaunchAuthentication to temporarily transfer a call into a specified IVR flow. After invoking this API, the call enters an IVR interaction phase, which is commonly used for identity verification operations
description_zh: 调用LaunchAuthentication使通话临时转入指定的IVR流程，调用此接口后，会在通话过程中进入IVR交互环节，通用用于核身操作
kebab_example: aliyun ccc launch-authentication --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id ACC-YUNBS-1.0.10-0000 --job-id job-65382141036850000 --contact-flow-id af145gfc-1108-4d55-8fca-f719bd512ebb --contact-flow-variables customerID_:_2088802818310000_,_operateType_:_cipherCode_,_taskId_:_1234567890_,_crmOther_:_123 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: LaunchAuthentication

parameters.help_en: The agent ID that initiates identity verification
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled in with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The contact flow ID for the IVR identity verification flow
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.help_en: Variables passed to the contact flow. This parameter is optional. The configured variables can be retrieved and used within the IVR flow. The format is a JSON string representing a collection of key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 传递给联系流的变量，选填，这里配置的变量，可以在IVR流程中拿到并使用，格式为JSON字符串格式的键值对集合
parameters.name: contact_flow_variables
